L84: L85: screenshot.png uploading L86: L87: trace.log 38 KB L88: L89: [Input: Ask anything] L90: L91: fig. 01 · plays once, replay from the corner L92: ## Installation L93: L94: Install manually L95: L96: [Button: Runtime][Button: Standalone] L97: L98: [Button: npm][Button: pnpm][Button: yarn][Button: bun][Button: xpm] L99: L100: `npx shadcn@latest add "@assistant-ui/elements-composer"` L101: L102: First time? Set up a runtime L103: L104: Runtime components read their state from an assistant-ui runtime. Add one to an existing project: L105: L106: `npx assistant-ui@latest init` L107: Then wrap your app in a runtime provider: L108: L109: `import { AssistantRuntimeProvider } from "@assistant-ui/react"; L110: import { useChatRuntime, AssistantChatTransport } from "@assistant-ui/ai-sdk"; L111: L112: export default function App() { L113: const runtime = useChatRuntime({ L114: transport: new AssistantChatTransport({ api: "/api/chat" }), L115: }); L116: L117: return ( L118: L119: {/* your components */} L120: L121: ); L122: }` L123: The 【176†installation guide】 covers new projects, templates, and API routes. L124: L125: [Button: npm][Button: pnpm][Button: yarn][Button: bun][Button: xpm] L126: L127: `npx shadcn@latest add "@assistant-ui/elements-composer"` L128: L129: Props-driven: no runtime or provider required. L130: A file added to the composer becomes a chip: an icon for its kind, its name and size, and a trailing slot that carries a spinner while it uploads and a remove button once it is done. With a runtime the chip tracks a real upload through an attachment adapter; standalone you hold the list of files and their state yourself. L131: ## 【177†Getting started】 L132: L133: A composer stages files the same way it stages text: `aui.composer.addAttachment(file)` adds one, an `AttachmentAdapter` turns it into a `PendingAttachment` and then a `CompleteAttachment`, and `s.composer.attachments` reflects the list at every step. L134: ### 【178†Configure an attachment adapter】 L135: L136: Attachments are opt-in: without an adapter, `s.thread.capabilities.attachments` is `false` and `AddAttachment`, paste, and drop all no-op. assistant-ui ships adapters for the common cases: L137: app/chat-provider.tsx L138: L139: `import { useLocalRuntime, CompositeAttachmentAdapter, SimpleImageAttachmentAdapter, SimpleTextAttachmentAdapter } from "@assistant-ui/react"; L140: L141: const runtime = useLocalRuntime(chatModel, { L142: adapters: { L143: attachments: new CompositeAttachmentAdapter([ L144: new SimpleImageAttachmentAdapter(), L145: new SimpleTextAttachmentAdapter(), L146: ]), L147: }, L148: });` L149: ### 【179†Add and list attachments】 L150: components/assistant-ui/elements/composer-attachments.tsx L151: L152: `"use client"; L153: L154: import { ComposerPrimitive, AttachmentPrimitive } from "@assistant-ui/react"; L155: import { PlusIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react"; L156: import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"; L157: import { field, ghostButton } from "@/components/assistant-ui/elements/surfaces"; L158: L159: export function ComposerAttachmentsRow() { L160: return ( L161: L162: {({ attachment }) => ( L163: L166: L167: L168: L169: {attachment.status.type !== "running" && ( L170: L171: L172: L173: )} L174: L175: )} L176: L177: ); L178: } L179: L180: export function AddAttachmentButton() { L181: return ( L182: L183: L184: L185: ); L186: }` L187: `ComposerPrimitive.Attachments` is a render-prop over every staged file; `AttachmentPrimitive.Root` scopes `.Name`, `.Remove`, and `.unstable_Thumb` to the attachment at that position, so they need no index or id passed in by hand. `AddAttachment` opens a native file picker filtered to `s.composer.attachmentAccept` (the adapter's `accept`, or every file type when none is configured). L188: ### 【180†Accept drag-and-drop】 L189: L190: ` L191: {/* the rest of the bar */} L192: ` L193: `AttachmentDropzone` sets `data-dragging="true"` while a file is dragged over it and stages every dropped file the same way `addAttachment` does; it claims the drop even without an adapter configured, so an unprevented drop never navigates the tab away to the file. L194: L195: Standalone, a chip is a pure function of a `ComposerAttachment` object: nothing here uploads a file or tracks progress on its own. You own the array and mutate it as an upload proceeds. L196: ### 【181†Hold the attachment list】 L197: app/chat-box.tsx L198: L199: `"use client"; L200: L201: import { useState } from "react"; L202: import { ComposerAttachments, ComposerAttachmentChip, type ComposerAttachment } from "@/components/assistant-ui/elements/composer"; L203: L204: export function ChatBox() { L205: const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState([]); L206: L207: const remove = (name: string) => L208: setAttachments((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.name !== name)); L209: L210: return ( L211: L212: {attachments.map((attachment) => ( L213: L214: ))} L215: L216: ); L217: }` L218: ### 【182†Drive the upload yourself】 L219: L220: `async function upload(file: File) { L221: const attachment: ComposerAttachment = { name: file.name, meta: "0%", state: "uploading", progress: 0, kind: "image" }; L222: setAttachments((prev) => [...prev, attachment]); L223: L224: await uploadWithProgress(file, (progress) => L225: setAttachments((prev) => prev.map((a) => (a.name === file.name ? { ...a, progress, meta: `${progress}%` } : a))), L226: ); L227: setAttachments((prev) => prev.map((a) => (a.name === file.name ? { ...a, state: "done", meta: formatSize(file.size) } : a))); L228: }` L229: ## 【183†Anatomy】 L230: L231: `
L232: {/* icon: image, text, or archive, by kind */} L233: L234: {/* name */} L235: {/* meta; turns red when state is "error" */} L236: L237: {/* trailing slot */} L238: {/* progress bar along the bottom edge, only while uploading */} L239:
` L240: The trailing slot has three outcomes: uploading shows a spinner; done with an `onRemove` handler shows a remove button; done with no `onRemove` shows a check mark. An `"error"` state shows none of the three (only the red meta text), matching the runtime's own `"incomplete"` status, which carries a `message` but no built-in retry. L241: ## 【184†Examples】 L242: ### 【185†Upload progress】 L243: `aui.composer.getState().attachments[i].status` is `{ type: "running", reason: "uploading", progress }` while an adapter streams a `PendingAttachment`; read it to drive your own progress bar, or use `AttachmentPrimitive.unstable_Thumb`, which falls back to the file's extension or MIME type when no thumbnail is supplied. L244: L245: `const status = useAuiState((s) => s.attachment.status); L246: // { type: "running", reason: "uploading", progress: 42 } while uploading L247: // { type: "complete" } once sent` L248: The catalog chip reads `progress` directly and widens a blue bar to match it while `state` is `"uploading"`; once you flip `state` to `"done"`, the bar disappears rather than sitting at full width. L249: L250: `` L251: ### 【186†Restyle the chip】 L252: L253: Both lanes take `className` on the outer element; the icon square, the two-line label, and the trailing slot are laid out with `flex` and don't need to move together. L254: L255: `` L256: ### 【187†Once the message is sent】 L257: L258: Attachments in the composer are still local and removable; once a message sends, they live inside that message instead, read-only. 【135†Attachment】 covers the runtime message-side rendering, and its 【188†received-files design】 covers the equivalent standalone piece. L259: L260: ## 【189†API reference】 L261: ### 【190†ComposerPrimitive】 L262: Part | Renders | Notes L263: --- | --- | --- L264: `Attachments` | render prop | `{({ attachment }) => ReactNode}`, once per staged file. L265: `AttachmentByIndex` | wrapper | Renders one attachment at a fixed `index`; used internally by `Attachments`. L266: `AddAttachment` | `button` | Opens a native file picker filtered to `attachmentAccept`; disabled only while the composer is not editable, so a pick made with no adapter configured opens the picker but silently fails to add the file. L267: `AttachmentDropzone` | `div` (or `asChild`) | `data-dragging="true"` while a file drag is over it; drops call `addAttachment` per file. L268: ### 【191†AttachmentPrimitive】 L269: Part | Renders | Notes L270: --- | --- | --- L271: `Root` | `div` | Scopes `.Name`, `.Remove`, and `.unstable_Thumb` to the attachment at this position. Must be inside `ComposerPrimitive.Attachments` (or `MessagePrimitive.Attachments`, for an attachment already on a sent message). L272: `Name` | text | The attachment's `name`. L273: `Remove` | `button` | Calls `aui.attachment.remove()`. L274: `unstable_Thumb` | `div` | Renders its `children`, or falls back to the file extension (or MIME type) as text. L275: ### 【192†Composer and attachment state】 L276: Selector | Type | Description L277: --- | --- | --- L278: `s.composer.attachments` | `readonly Attachment[]` | Every file staged on this composer. L279: `s.composer.attachmentAccept` | `string` | The configured adapter's `accept`, or `"*"`. L280: `s.thread.capabilities.attachments` | `boolean` | Whether an attachment adapter is configured at all. L281: `s.attachment.name` / `.type` / `.contentType?` | `string` | Identity of the attachment in scope. L282: `s.attachment.status` | `PendingAttachmentStatus | CompleteAttachmentStatus` | See below. L283: `aui.composer.addAttachment(file)` | `(file: File | CreateAttachment) => Promise` | Stages a file. L284: `aui.composer.clearAttachments()` | `() => Promise` | Removes every staged attachment. L285: `PendingAttachmentStatus` is `{ type: "running", reason: "uploading", progress: number }`, `{ type: "requires-action", reason: "composer-send" }` (uploaded, waiting to be sent), or `{ type: "incomplete", reason: "error" | "upload-paused", message?: string }`. `CompleteAttachmentStatus` is `{ type: "complete" }`. L286: ### 【193†ComposerAttachment】 L287: L288: Field | Type | Description L289: --- | --- | --- L290: `name` | `string` | Shown as the chip's label. L291: `meta` | `string` | The line under the name (size, percent, or an error hint). L292: `state` | `"uploading" | "done" | "error"` | Drives the icon, the trailing slot, and the meta text color. L293: `progress` | `number` | Width of the progress bar, out of 100, while `state` is `"uploading"`. L294: `kind` | `"image" | "text" | "archive"` | Selects the leading icon. @default renders the text icon L295: ### 【194†ComposerAttachments / ComposerAttachmentChip】 L296: L297: Prop | Type | Default | Description L298: --- | --- | --- | --- L299: `attachment` | `ComposerAttachment` | required | The file to render (`ComposerAttachmentChip` only). L300: `onRemove` | `(name: string) => void` | | Shown as a remove button once `state` is `"done"`; a check mark renders instead when omitted. L301: `className` | `string` | | Merged onto the root.
